thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Plans Quarterly Dividend of $0.73

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Plans Quarterly Dividend of $0.73
text:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) declared a quarterly dividend on Thursday, November 1st, RTT News reports. Stockholders of record on Monday, November 12th will be paid a dividend of 0.73 per share by the iPhone maker on Thursday, November 15th. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.31%.
Apple has raised its dividend by an average of 10.1% per year over the last three years and has increased its dividend annually for the last 5 consecutive years. Apple has a dividend payout ratio of 24.8% indicating that its dividend is sufficiently covered by earnings. Analysts expect Apple to earn $13.52 per share next year, which means the company should continue to be able to cover its $2.92 annual dividend with an expected future payout ratio of 21.6%.
